_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Kei te tākaro koe i te Solitaire o Klondike. Ko tō whāinga he neke i ngā kāri katoa ki ngā pūhanga tūāpapa.

Ngā Ture o te Kēmu:
- Ngā pūhanga tūāpapa (F1-F4): Hangaia ake i te Ace ki te King i te kākahu
- Ngā pūhanga tēpū (T1-T7): Hangaia iho i ngā tae hāngai (whero i runga i te pango, pango i runga i te whero)
- Stock: Tīkina ngā kāri ki te pūhanga para
- Para (W): Ko te kāri o runga hei tākaro

Ngā Whakahau:
- 'draw' - Tīkina ngā kāri i te stock ki te para
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Neke i ngā kāri i waenga i ngā pūhanga
  Tauira: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. Ka taea hoki te 'all', ka whakamātau ki te neke i ngā kāri katoa e tirohia ana.
- 'forfeit' - Whakamutua te kēmu tonu ātātou, ā, mau ki tō kaiwhiwhi ināianei
- Ingoa pūhanga: W (para), F1-F4 (tūāpapa), T1-T7 (tēpū)

Ka taea e koe te whakahaere i ngā mahi maha i te wā kotahi mā te wehewehe i a rātou ki ngā koma:
  Tauira: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Ko ngā King anake ka taea te whakatakoto ki ngā pūhanga tēpū kau.
Ka whakahaere ngā mahi i te otinga - ki te hinga tētahi, ka kore te whakahaere i ngā mahi e toe ana.
Whakamahia 'forfeit' ki te whakapono koe kāore e taea te wikitoria te kēmu.

format_error.unknown_command: Kāore e mōhio ki te whakahau '{cmd}'. Whakamahia 'draw', 'move <source> <destination> [count]', 'forfeit' rānei
